workload.what: a decoder used the way a model is used: one prefill, then greedy decode steps, each fed the device's own token and cache (R40-09: >= 4 layers, >= 64 MiB of weights, prefill >= 512, >= 64 decode steps)
workload.reference: eager PyTorch in binary32 on the CPU: every step against the reference given the same inputs (the device's own tokens and cache) at tolerance 0.05, and the generated ids against a generation run wholly in the reference, a differing id accepted only where the reference's two logits nearly tie (archbench/generate.py)

comparison: original frozen generate.py IEEE fp32 CPU reference equals both state-wrapper reference runs
native_precondition: qualified final three-core image and successful original >=64 MiB Torch vertical checkpoint
native_branch_review: completion/quiesce/CPU handoff and validation transfers recorded; not yet executed on final image
